projects.scope: Implement po_save(dst,arch,registers) copying only po_saved registers into a zero-filled32-slot image; reject arch>1 before mutation. po_restore validates image arch equals requested arch and copies only saved slots into a live register model, preserving others. projects.scope: Implement po_sign12(raw) for the low12 bits as a mathematical signed value -2048..2047, ignoring higher bits. Implement po_branch(delta,bits,align) accepting only bits2..30, align2 or4 and aligned signed delta in [-2^(bits-1),2^(bits-1)-align]. Use this as a relocation admission oracle, not as a complete instruction encoder.
projects.remaining_evidence: Actual cross-linked image runs, hostile-register context tests, trap return and two-address-space translation observations in both dedicated guests are mandatory; model tests are not a complete OS port.

projects.scope: Implement po_trap(status,from_supervisor) and po_return(status): trap records spp, copies sie to spie and clears sie; return restores sie from spie, sets spie1 and clears spp. Inputs are boolean fields; invalid input rejects without mutation. Compare the explicit model to supervisor CSR traces in a dedicated RV guest.
projects.remaining_evidence: Actual cross-linked image runs, hostile-register context tests, trap return and two-address-space translation observations in both dedicated guests are mandatory; model tests are not a complete OS port.

projects.scope: Implement po_access(user_page,supervisor,sum,mxr,r,w,x,operation), with boolean flags and op0 read,1 write,2 execute. User execution rejects supervisor-only pages. Supervisor execution always rejects user pages; supervisor reads/writes user pages require sum. Read requires r or mxr&&x; write requires w; execute requires x. This models the inspected SUM/MXR obligations, not a complete page walk.
